propositions: The close path grants disposition-closed bugs (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) an exemption from completion verification, minting no completion-verifier attestation
The certification path does not honor that exemption and requires a valid completion-verifier attestation on every closed child, withheld for disposition-closed children without non-force remedy
A disposition-closed bug with a live replacement link cannot earn certification: reopening and re-closing takes the same exemption branch producing identical unsigned state
The gap creates an inversion where honestly-linked duplicates stay unsigned while undeclared duplicates can certify

The fix provides a deterministic completion-verifier attestation for disposition closes with a live replacement link, recording the disposition class and replacement ticket instead of claiming a completion PASS
